demos.name: Personal Agent Flow
demos.description: How an AI assistant reaches a member's benefits through an MCP gateway in twelve steps: discovery, client metadata (CIMD), sign-in and consent, signed code exchange, gateway validation and a fine-grained policy decision. React Flow sequence diagram with decoded mock token JSON under each message, a simulated held-action approval, talk track and presenter mode. Mock only.
demos.notes: Host-run: ./scripts/run.sh (port 6900). Mock only: no tenant, no credentials. Docker: HOST_PORT=6900 docker compose up --build -d (published on 127.0.0.1 only). Brand it with customer.config.json (see customer.config.example.json). Hosted SE build: not deployed yet (first deploy is owner-approved).
